rules.description: No open chargeback exists on the order.
The refund currency equals the payment currency.
The amount is at most the captured amount minus refunds already issued.
The amount and currency equal the customer's request on the ticket.
No other ticket for the same order and reason was already refunded.
The reason is damaged, or the return is in transit or received.
The amount is within the policy's auto-approve limit.
